name: Hookrail Self-Hosted Webhook Delivery
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed self-hosted Go webhook delivery service with durable PostgreSQL-backed at-least-once delivery, retries, HMAC signing, idempotency, dead-letter replay and per-endpoint rate limiting; no vendor-imposed software event quota or expiry.
watch_out: No free managed webhook hosting, VPS, PostgreSQL, Redis or network capacity is included. Operate and secure your own infrastructure and dashboard; at-least-once delivery may duplicate events, so consumers need idempotency. Project is pre-1.0 without compatibility guarantees; protect admin credentials and follow Apache-2.0 notice obligations.
